properties.description: Originally founded in Oakland, this coffee brand revolutionized the specialty scene by prioritizing peak freshness through precise, made-to-order roasting and brewing. It has since grown into a globally recognized retailer, known for its clean aesthetic and commitment to high-quality single-origin beans. The brand sits at the intersection of artisanal craft and modern café retail, appealing to consumers who view coffee as a refined sensory experience. Despite its acquisition by a major conglomerate, it maintains its focus on ethical sourcing and sophisticated, simple presentation.

properties.description: Based in Toronto, this professional baseball franchise competes in Major League Baseball as the only Canadian team in the league. Since its inception in 1977, the organization has established itself as a centerpiece of national pride and sports entertainment. It provides top-tier athletic competition, live stadium experiences, and a wide array of broadcast media for a broad, multigenerational fan base. Owned by Rogers Communications, the entity balances its heritage as a long-standing sports institution with a commitment to high-level competitive performance and community engagement across the nation.
properties.short_description: The Toronto Blue Jays are a professional Major League Baseball team based in Toronto, known for their competitive play and popular players like Vladimir Guerrero Jr.

properties.description: Starbucks is a leading multinational coffeehouse chain known for its signature roasts, handcrafted beverages, and focus on creating a welcoming community atmosphere. Founded in Seattle’s Pike Place Market in 1971, the brand has grown into a global institution that prioritizes human connection alongside high-quality coffee. Its business model relies on a widespread retail footprint, offering a consistent customer experience for millions of daily visitors worldwide. The company remains focused on ethical sourcing and professional barista training to maintain its market position as the standard-bearer for accessible, premium café experiences.

properties.description: Established in 1939, this seminal American record label is widely considered the definitive name in jazz music. It is responsible for documenting decades of improvisational history, blending legendary archival releases with cutting-edge contemporary projects. Beyond its catalog, the label is globally recognized for its signature modernist aesthetic that has deeply influenced graphic design. It operates as a heritage institution within the music industry, maintaining a reputation for artistic integrity and production excellence.
